test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 8 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
How many triangles are there in the given figure ?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3a49569756adea7b4f0e86c594ca025c87e5e41556b63e6e6c16a4f71b046b7e.png]
solution:
Here, we need to count total number of triangle.

First we will count all the small triangles as:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a4dcaf3735e308da8bcd3b2cba961a245663d91fb655c585807a8cbf5f961b6c.png] 

So, we have 10 triangles.

Next, we will combine two or more triangles, we will have,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d4f1f2f1cebb6363bbb37111dca75a56c2667e101efeec35064640cc4a015f8f.png] 

So, triangles we have are: PQS, PQT, PQU, PRT, PRU, PSU, PVX, PVY, PVZ, PWY, PWZ, PXZ - total of 12 triangles.

Thus, we have a total of 10 + 12 = 22 triangles.

Hence, we have __**22**__ triangles.
